hardware.cell_library: ASAP7 RVT/TT combinational and sequential cells

interface.sampling: Inputs stable before rising edge; outputs observed after that edge; first input edge is cycle 0.

scoring.resolved: all required functional, numerical, protocol, service, latency, mapped-netlist and timing checks pass; no area or score cutoff
scoring.efficiency: 64/(A*II_verified*T_STA); STA-supported sample throughput per full mapped area
scoring.reference_selection: single accurate implementation with maximum measured STA-supported throughput/area in the identical backend, flow and protocol
scoring.period: effective_required_period_ns from fixed-constraint pre-layout STA, including setup uncertainty
scoring.frame_II: offered workload interval serviced correctly on the complete RTL and mapped tests; currently 384 cycles; not claimed intrinsic minimum II
scoring.missing_calibration: hardware feasibility reported separately; score_valid=false; rerun calibration
scoring.measurement_stage: pre-layout synthesis and ideal-interconnect STA; not post-route or physical-device Fmax

verification.rtl: VCS four-state, ordinary unspecified initial state and synchronous-reset checks
verification.mapped: VCS four-state logic, full RTL comparison from three time-zero register initializations: all zero, all one, and seed 20261121
verification.initialization_scope: time zero only; no forcing or repair during reset, processing or output
verification.motivation: avoid false failures from reconvergent reset X-pessimism while requiring recovery from multiple physical binary initial states
verification.guarantee: empirical full-transaction RTL/netlist equivalence; optional formal proof is reported separately
